DEU.tuition: 0€ Tuition at almost all Public Universities (Only €250-€350/sem semester ticket)
DEU.psw: 18 Months Job Search Visa (EU Blue Card path in 21-27 months)
DEU.ielts: Safe: 6.5 (min 6.0 in all bands); Top TUs: 7.0; MOI acceptable in selected private/partner universities
DEU.visaDhaka: German Embassy Dhaka uses CSP / waiting list system (apply early as appointment queue can take 8-14 months)
DEU.successTip: Apply through uni-assist or direct university portals by July 15 for Winter intake. DAAD EPOS requires 2 years of work experience.

GBR.tuition: £14,000 - £26,000 / year (Wide scholarships from £2,000 discounts up to 100% Chevening/Commonwealth)
GBR.blockedAccount: 28-day Bank Solvency (Tuition balance + 9 months living cost)
GBR.psw: 2 Years Graduate Route Visa (3 Years for PhD)
GBR.ielts: Overall 6.0 to 6.5 (many UK universities accept MOI / Duolingo or offer internal English test)
GBR.cgpa: Undergrad: HSC GPA 4.0+ / Masters: 2.75+ for general, 3.3+ for Russell Group
GBR.visaDhaka: VFS Global Dhaka (Processing 3-4 weeks standard, 5 days priority)
GBR.successTip: UK CAS issuance requires strict credibility audit and genuine student intent. Chevening deadline is early November.

USA.tuition: $20,000 - $55,000 / year (Extensive Assistantships: TA/RA covering 100% tuition + monthly stipend for STEM Masters/PhD)
USA.blockedAccount: I-20 financial proof (1 year tuition + living demonstrated in bank sponsor)
USA.psw: 3 Years STEM OPT (1 Year for non-STEM) with H-1B lottery eligibility
USA.cgpa: Safe: 3.2+; Competitive for TA/RA: 3.5+ with research publications or GRE
USA.visaDhaka: US Embassy Dhaka F-1 Visa interview (Crucial: Strong home ties, funding clarity, academic readiness)
USA.successTip: For graduate studies, contact professors directly with research fit. Fulbright deadline is usually May/June in Dhaka.

ITA.tuition: Low public university fees based on ISEE-Parificato family income (€150 - €2,000/yr)
ITA.blockedAccount: Approx €6,000 - €7,000 in sponsor account (DSU recipients can get living stipend + free canteen)
ITA.psw: 1 Year Post-Study Permesso di Soggiorno (Job search or entrepreneurship)
ITA.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 (Some universities accept English MOI letter from Bangladesh)
ITA.visaDhaka: Italian Embassy Dhaka (Requires Universitaly pre-enrolment, CIMEA / DoV, and VFS booking)
ITA.successTip: Regional scholarships like DSU (Tuscany/Lombardy), LazioDisco (Rome), ER.GO (Bologna) cover up to €7,500/year plus free meals!

NLD.tuition: €10,000 - €18,000 / year for Non-EU (Subsidized by NL Scholarship and university excellence funds)
NLD.blockedAccount: Approx €14,000 / year deposited to university account for IND visa sponsor
NLD.psw: 1 Year 'Zoekjaar' (Orientation Year) visa for high-skilled job search
NLD.ielts: Strict IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0) or 7.0 for research masters
NLD.cgpa: Minimum 3.2+; Strong analytical/math foundation verified on Studielink
NLD.visaDhaka: IND institutional sponsor handles MVV; student collects sticker at Dutch Embassy Dhaka within 2-3 weeks
NLD.successTip: High English proficiency across 95% of society. Apply early (by Jan/Feb) for university housing as student housing is competitive.

SWE.tuition: SEK 90,000 - 150,000 / year (SI Global Professionals covers 100% tuition + SEK 12,000/mo stipend + travel grant)
SWE.blockedAccount: SEK 10,500/month for Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) residence permit
SWE.psw: 1 Year Job Search Visa after graduation
SWE.ielts: Strict English 6 requirement: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 5.5)
SWE.cgpa: Competitive: 3.3+ with 3,000 hours of demonstrated leadership/work experience for SI
SWE.visaDhaka: Swedish Migration Agency online permit + biometric verification at Swedish Embassy Dhaka
SWE.successTip: Centralized application via UniversityAdmissions.se opens in October and closes mid-January. SI application opens in February.

FIN.tuition: €10,000 - €13,000 / year (Finland Scholarship awards 100% waiver + €5,000 relocation grant; Universities offer 50-100% waivers)
FIN.blockedAccount: €6,720 / year (€560/month) required by Migri for student residence permit
FIN.psw: 2 Years Job Search Residence Permit (one of the most generous in Europe!)
FIN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0/4.0; 3.4+ strongly positioned for Finland Scholarship award
FIN.visaDhaka: Migri online application + VFS Dhaka biometric appointment
FIN.successTip: Joint Application (Studyinfo.fi) takes place in January for August intake. Students can work up to 30 hours per week!

JPN.tuition: National universities: ¥535,800/yr (approx $3,500 USD) + 50% or 100% tuition exemption available for foreign students
JPN.blockedAccount: Sponsor bank balance of 15-20 Lakh BDT for COE (Certificate of Eligibility)
JPN.psw: Designated Activities Visa for 1-2 years job hunting in Japan
JPN.ielts: IELTS 6.0 - 6.5 for English-taught degree programs (SGU / Global 30)
JPN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0+; MEXT Embassy Track requires high academic standing and written exam
JPN.visaDhaka: Japanese Embassy Dhaka issues visa within 5-7 working days after receiving university COE
JPN.successTip: MEXT Scholarship covers 100% tuition + ¥144,000/month stipend + return airfare! University recommendation track deadline is Dec-Jan.

KOR.tuition: $2,000 - $5,000 / semester (Very generous university scholarships 30%-100% based on GPA/TOPIK)
KOR.blockedAccount: Approx $10,000 - $20,000 bank statement depending on whether university is inside Seoul
KOR.psw: D-10 Job Seeker Visa for up to 2 years with point-based transition to E-7 work visa
KOR.ielts: IELTS 5.5 - 6.5 for English programs, or TOPIK Level 3+ for Korean programs
KOR.cgpa: Minimum 2.8+; GKS scholarship requires top 20% ranking (CGPA 3.3+)
KOR.visaDhaka: Korean Embassy Dhaka (requires Apostille / Embassy legalisation of academic certificates)
KOR.successTip: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) covers 100% tuition, monthly 1,000,000 KRW stipend, 1 year Korean language training, and airfare.

CAN.blockedAccount: GIC (Guaranteed Investment Certificate) approx CAD $20,635 + first year tuition receipt
CAN.psw: Up to 3 Years Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)
CAN.ielts: Strict IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0) for university admission & study permit
CAN.cgpa: Minimum 3.0+; Graduate research positions offer RA/TA stipends
CAN.visaDhaka: IRCC online application + VFS Dhaka biometric appointment
CAN.successTip: Research-based Master's in STEM often come with funded supervisor packages. Vanier and Trudeaux scholarships available for PhD.

AUS.tuition: AUD $28,000 - $46,000 / year (Vice-Chancellor scholarships offer 20%-50% tuition reduction)
AUS.livingCost: AUD $2,000 / month (annual requirement: AUD $29,710 for visa)
AUS.blockedAccount: Demonstrated 1-year living cost + remaining tuition + travel in credible bank history
AUS.psw: 2 to 4 Years Temporary Graduate (subclass 485) visa based on qualification & regional campus
AUS.ielts: IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 in each band) or PTE 58-64
AUS.cgpa: Bachelor: 2.8+ / Master: 3.0+ (Group of Eight universities expect 3.2+)
AUS.visaDhaka: Subclass 500 online visa via ImmiAccount + biometrics at VFS Dhaka (Genuine Student GS audit)
AUS.successTip: Australia Awards (AAS) is 100% funded for Bangladeshi mid-career professionals. RTP scholarships cover full PhD fees + $32k stipend.

HUN.blockedAccount: Stipendium Hungaricum awardees are exempt from bank solvency!
HUN.psw: 9 Months Study-to-Work visa for job seeking in Hungary
HUN.cgpa: Minimum 2.8/4.0; Competitive for BD Education Ministry quota: 3.2+
HUN.visaDhaka: Hungarian Embassy New Delhi / Consular services in Dhaka (Excellence Global assists with paperwork)
HUN.successTip: Stipendium Hungaricum is one of the most accessible full-funding schemes for BD students: 100% tuition + monthly stipend + dorm/housing subsidy + health insurance! Application deadline: mid-January via DreamApply & BD MoE.

TUR.tuition: 100% Free under Türkiye Bursları (Public university fees are very low: $300-$1,500/yr)
TUR.blockedAccount: Türkiye Bursları winners are 100% exempt from financial deposits
TUR.psw: Short-term residence permit for job seeking in Turkey
TUR.ielts: English programs require IELTS 6.5; Turkish programs provide 1 year free language prep
TUR.visaDhaka: Turkish Embassy Dhaka (Direct visa issuance upon presenting TB scholarship award letter)
TUR.successTip: Türkiye Bursları offers 100% free tuition, monthly stipend, university dorm accommodation, health insurance, and round-trip flight tickets! Apply annually from Jan 10 to Feb 20.

SAU.tuition: 100% Free Tuition for accepted international graduate students at top universities (KAUST, KFUPM, KSU)
SAU.livingCost: Zero (Fully covered by scholarship stipends + free on-campus housing)
SAU.blockedAccount: None required — universities provide full sponsorship
SAU.psw: High demand for AI, Petroleum, Renewable Energy, and Biotech specialists in Vision 2030 initiatives
SAU.ielts: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 79 for KAUST / KFUPM
SAU.visaDhaka: Saudi Embassy Dhaka visa section through university electronic visa (Wakala)
SAU.successTip: KAUST Fellowship is one of the world's most generous awards: 100% tuition waiver + $20,000 to $30,000 annual living stipend + free private apartment + relocation flights + medical coverage!
